S2-day2-pipeline.inputs: Locked DESIGN.md section 6, reviewed Day 1 package, plan/config files and injected model/search interfaces
S2-day2-pipeline.outputs: Plain typed agents, LangGraph slot lanes, public week/piece CLIs, Pillow visuals, JSON trails and terminal CSV/summary
S2-day2-pipeline.ordering: Resolve research then parallel write/validate/review/retry/visual lanes; accepted only export in plan order after one join
S2-day2-pipeline.emptyBehavior: Invalid plan/config fails before calls; no evidence fails its slot; zero accepted still exports headers and summary
S2-day2-pipeline.errorBehavior: One shared content retry, bounded transport repairs, fail-closed review, isolated terminal failures, grounded visual/spec fallback
S2-day2-pipeline.permissions: Project-local code and safe run outputs, public research only; no secrets in logs, live model calls, publishing, merge or deployment
